output.summary: Validate archive hydrate stubs against archived close metadata.

approvedRows.question: Should hydrate reject retention stubs whose restore refs or closed/open state do not match archived records?
approvedRows.currentState: Hydration only checked trace id, so a stub could claim a different gitRestoreRef or closed state than the archived trace records actually contain.
approvedRows.desiredState: Hydration verifies trace id, closed/open state, restore ref, head ref, close time, and close reason before returning a restore plan.
approvedRows.rationale: Archive hydration is an audit boundary; stale or mismatched restore refs must not be accepted silently.
approvedRows.userImpact: Users get safer restore/hydrate plans that cannot silently use mismatched archive metadata.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Maintainers get regression tests for closed-trace hydrate validation.
approvedRows.recommendationRationale: Evidence supports this intention as valuable and safe to plan.

agentAssessment.rationale: No lower-cost alternative better serves the user and project.
